name: Vooshka Cocktail Bar
areasNote: Mobile bar experiences across England and Wales
description:
Vooshka is a luxury mobile cocktail bar bringing exquisite drinks and elevated hospitality to events across the UK. Bespoke bars, exceptional cocktails and complete drinks service for weddings, private celebrations and corporate events nationwide.

A great bar brings people together. At Vooshka, distinctive design, expertly made drinks and a warm welcome create a natural gathering place at the heart of your celebration. From intimate gatherings to grand receptions, we work with you to find the right look, menu and style of service.

media.alt: At the heart of the occasion
Expert service, from cocktails to draught beer

info.title: The Vooshka experience
info.lead: A little theatre. A lot of elegance.
info.text: You bring the people and the reason to celebrate; we’ll take care of the bar.

info.title: The Vooshka process
info.quote: Not just a bar. A beautiful part of your celebration.

info.title: Bar styles
info.text: Ordered by overall span, from smallest to largest. Made-to-measure designs appear last. All bars are 1.2 m high.

info_vk_why.name: Your Bar, Bespoke
info_vk_why.description: Created to complement your occasion. Work with our design team to tailor the size, style and finish of your bar, from understated elegance to a striking centrepiece.

info_vk_why.name: Drinks with Personality
info_vk_why.description: Your favourites, alongside something new to discover. Choose from classic cocktails, signature creations and alcohol-free serves, with a menu that reflects your tastes and gives every guest something to enjoy.

info_vk_why.name: Care in Every Detail
info_vk_why.description: Quality spirits, fresh ingredients and precise preparation make the difference. From the balance of a cocktail to the glass and garnish, each serve is finished with care.

info_vk_why.name: Expert Team
info_vk_why.description: Skilled bartenders, creative mixologists and accomplished flair bartenders bring exceptional drinks and effortless hosting to your occasion, with a touch of theatre when the moment calls for it.

info_vk_steps.name: It Begins With You
info_vk_steps.description: Our team will take you through the details of your event, exploring your vision, your venue and the atmosphere you’d like to create. Together, we’ll shape a bar experience that feels entirely yours.

info_vk_steps.name: The Details, Designed Around You
info_vk_steps.description: Enjoy a personal tasting with our mixologist to create a drinks menu for your occasion. Work alongside our design team to select your bar style and develop bespoke artwork, bringing your vision to life.

info_vk_steps.name: A Date to Look Forward To
info_vk_steps.description: Once you’re happy with your proposal, return your signed agreement and pay the agreed deposit to secure your date.

info_vk_steps.name: We’ll Take It From Here
info_vk_steps.description: We’ll confirm the final arrangements and coordinate with your venue. From setup to the last drink and breakdown, our team takes care of the bar, leaving you free to enjoy the occasion.

web_reviews.name: Pav
web_reviews.description: Just wanted to say a massive thank you to you & the team for the amazing cocktails at the wedding, you guys absolutely smashed it! Everyone really enjoyed them. Thanks for all your help, service was 💯👌🏽 Thank you again & look forward to using you again in the future❤️🫶🏼🍸

web_reviews.name: Jay
web_reviews.description: From our very first conversation, Vooshka understood exactly what we envisioned for our wedding and made it happen! The management team were so kind, respectful and polite, and nothing was ever too much trouble. The cocktails and mocktails tasted absolutely amazing, and so many of our guests commented on how good they were! The mixologists and bartenders were fantastic, so friendly and engaging with all our guests. The whole team really went above and beyond to make our day special. Couldn’t recommend Vooshka enough!

web_reviews.name: Vinny
web_reviews.description: We can’t recommend Vooshka enough! They absolutely smashed it at our wedding, from the initial planning right through to the day itself.  Raj and his team really listened to what we wanted and helped bring our vision to life. They also shared some great ideas to make the experience even better for our guests, from designing the menu and setting up the bar to creating a fantastic cocktail experience.  We had a tasting session with our family, which was a great touch, and even came up with some fun, quirky cocktail names to fit our wedding theme.  The cocktail bar was a massive hit with our guests and really added something special to the day. Raj and the team also had a few surprises up their sleeves, which helped take the party to another level!  The whole team were brilliant from start to finish, and their attention to detail and willingness to go the extra mile really made a difference.  A massive thank you to Raj and everyone at Vooshka for helping make our wedding so special. If you’re planning a wedding or event and want something a bit different, we’d 100% recommend them!

web_reviews.name: Maria
web_reviews.description: Amazing Cocktails and Fantastic Service!  The cocktails at our wedding were amazing, and all our guests raved about them! The tasting beforehand was a fantastic addition, allowing me to create cocktails that perfectly suited our wedding. The service was great, and the attention to detail was brilliant, with the cocktail board and menus designed to match our wedding theme. Everything felt personal and was done to such a high standard. The cocktails were a real highlight of our day, and I couldn’t recommend them enough to anyone looking for something special for their wedding or event. Thank you for making our day extra special!

qa.text: Do you offer a full bar service?
qa.note: Bespoke bars, cocktails, mocktails, spirits, wines, beers, draught beer and soft drinks.

qa.text: Do you travel across the UK?
qa.note: Mobile bar experiences across the UK. Share your venue or postcode to discuss availability and access.

qa.text: Do you design the bar around my event?
qa.note: Choose from 42 bar styles or ask for a made to measure design, with bespoke artwork.
Mocktails and soft drinks sit alongside the cocktails.

qa.text: Do you hold a tasting before the event?
qa.note: A personal tasting with our mixologist to create your drinks menu.

qa.text: Do you coordinate with my venue?
qa.note: We confirm final arrangements with your venue, from setup to breakdown.

qa.text: Does my venue need to provide space, access, power and water?
qa.note: Requirements depend on the bar and service you choose. We discuss them with you and your venue before the event.

qa.text: Does an enquiry reserve my date?
qa.note: Your date is secured once your signed agreement and deposit are received.
